'''Saper''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Pilot/Legends|Pilot]] that lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Around [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Saper was tasked with patrolling the [[Empire's Justice]] quadrant in the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]].
